issue.title: Green Master Gate and Full CI, then ship sase v0.18.0 through ci_watch
issue.description: Master Gate is green at master HEAD and a fresh Full CI run passes every job, so ci_watch merges release-please PR #299 and sase 0.18.0 installs from PyPI. The release-wait phase closes its bead on every path that does not need a human. The land agent confirms the release before it lands, and repairs the release itself when something unexpected blocks it.
